Description: Direct prompt to LLM without RAG; prone to severe hallucinations on niche artifacts.
Exact keyword matching; suffers from vocabulary mismatch and lack of confidence calibration.
Standard vector space model; fails on paraphrase queries without semantic embeddings.
Always generates answers; forces hallucination on all 40 OOD queries.
Uses gate tau=0.50 but lacks 3D spatial binding; fails on indexical queries like 'What is this?'.
Full proposed architecture: 3D deictic routing, tau=0.50 pre-LLM gate, 3-turn memory, 4-pillar XAI.
